newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB 5-year debenture trades at 4.10 pct - sources.
newsitem.headline: NCB 5-year debenture trades at 4.10 pct - sources.

text.p: A five-year bank debenture with a 2.15 percent coupon issued in January by Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) was traded at a yield of 4.10 percent in the secondary market on Tuesday, up from 4.0 percent on Monday, market sources said.
But the traded amount was small, they added.
Meanwhile, a 1.6 percent five-year debenture issued in January by the Industrial Bank of Japan (IBJ) was traded at 1.62 percent.
Asked about the rise in debenture yields, an official at the NCB said some institutional investors were selling ahead of the end of the fiscal year on March 31.
"As we have slightly reduced the amount of five-year debenture issues in the past two months, selling pressure is likely to ease," the official said.
"The recent rise in the NCB debenture yield seems to have gone too far," a brokerage house trader said.
